General Dynamics Mission Systems engineers high-technology solutions for defense and scientific missions. The company is seeking an entry-level Embedded Software Engineer to join a cross-functional Airborne Systems team developing software for airborne computers, crypto products, and weapon control systems. The role involves applying software engineering and agile development principles in a collaborative environment focused on mission-critical systems.
